title: Jujutsu High has a cursed technique with your name on it
dek: No domain expansions to name. Twelve questions about how you handle a fight, a team and a bad grade, and the school decides who you are.

results.name: YUJI ITADORI
results.blurb: You are the one who keeps getting up, and not because you're the strongest. You take on fights that were never yours, you refuse to accept that somebody has to die for this to work, and you are somehow still kind about it. Your power is that nobody can convince you to give up.
strengths: Refuses to give up on anyone
results.watchOut: You carry guilt that isn't yours. You are allowed to stop for a day.

results.name: MEGUMI FUSHIGURO
results.tagline: Has a plan and will not be telling you
results.blurb: You are quiet, deliberate and considerably more dangerous than the room assumes. You make decisions other people find cold and then turn out to have been right. Your loyalty is enormous but never announced, and it usually shows up as standing in a doorway you did not have to stand in.
strengths: Cool head in a bad situation
results.watchOut: You would rather handle it alone than explain yourself. Explain yourself once.

results.name: NOBARA KUGISAKI
results.tagline: Confident, correct, and holding a hammer
results.blurb: You have never once needed someone else's approval and it shows in everything you do. Your style is precise, personal and a little theatrical, and you take losses as information rather than identity. You are the friend who says the hard thing and then buys dinner.
results.watchOut: You would rather be right than ask for help. Ask anyway.

results.name: SATORU GOJO
results.blurb: You are the most capable person in most rooms and you have made that everyone's problem. You joke through serious moments, you arrive late on purpose, and underneath all of it you are carrying a plan nobody asked you to carry. You are exhausting and irreplaceable in equal measure.
results.watchOut: The bit is a shield. Let the people who love you see the tired version.

results.name: RYOMEN SUKUNA
results.tagline: You were here first and it shows
results.blurb: You do not negotiate and you do not explain. You are entirely self-possessed, extremely good at what you do, and uninterested in whether that makes you pleasant. People work around you rather than with you, and you have decided that is their problem, which it usually is.
results.watchOut: You treat cooperation as weakness. It is the only thing you're actually bad at.

results.name: MAKI ZENIN
results.blurb: You were told what you could not have and you built something better out of what was left. You are blunt, physically fearless and allergic to being underestimated. Your strength is not inherited, borrowed or blessed. It is the result of years nobody watched.
strengths: Refuses to be defined by a family
results.watchOut: You prove yourself constantly to people who don't matter. Stop.

results.name: TOGE INUMAKI
results.tagline: Says very little, means all of it
results.blurb: You are the most careful communicator in the group, because you understand exactly how much damage a sentence can do. You are funny in a way that takes people a week to notice, and you show up for your people with food, timing and absolutely no drama. Everyone trusts you. Nobody can explain why.
results.watchOut: You hold back so much that people miss what you meant. Say the plain version.

results.name: KENTO NANAMI
results.tagline: Clock in, do it properly, clock out
results.blurb: You are competent, boundaried and deeply tired. You do the job to an unreasonable standard, you refuse to be dramatic about it, and you have a private list of things worth the effort. People mistake your restraint for coldness. It is actually the most disciplined kindness in the building.
results.watchOut: You'll work past the point of sense. The bread is good. Go home.

results.name: AOI TODO
results.tagline: Needs a rival the way other people need sleep
results.blurb: You are loud, sincere and completely without shame about what you love. You decide instantly whether someone is your person, and then you commit at a volume that alarms bystanders. Competition is not aggression for you. It is how you say thank you.
strengths: Builds people up instead of down
results.watchOut: Not everyone wants to be your rival. Read the room before declaring one.

results.name: CHOSO
results.tagline: Would burn everything down for one person
results.blurb: You are quiet, intense and almost entirely motivated by a small number of people you have decided are yours. You do not need the group's approval and you are not interested in being understood. You are gentle with the ones who matter and unmoved by everyone else.
results.watchOut: Your circle is very small and very load-bearing. Widen it slightly.
